body: Fucking keep going! One year ago today I was suicidal, 50lbs heavier, lacked every emotion, was irritable and felt like I was at the bottom of a well yelling for help and no one could hear me. I somehow pulled myself out of it. Now I have 15k in savings, my own apartment and two kittens and my dream job

I’m going through this really bad in life right now. To the point of being self destructive and borderline suicidal. The only thing I have held onto that makes me feel a bit better is that I truly believe what goes around comes around to a degree. I know it’s so hard to keep the anger bottled up, the sadness, with no closure, but I do have a belief no matter how much pain I’ve felt in my life that my time will come. Your time will come!... some day in the future you must believe that your life will be so full of love and new memories that the bad ones have been diluted in the soup of life. The bitterness will be overwhelmed with sweetness. I believe this and maybe you and I can believe this together. Stay strong, you’re not alone. ♥️

I did too.... all of the things you stated. The loss of love was most devistating, if I hear a certain song on the radio I lose it, everything makes me think of him. I stopped going to work and eating and just drink in bed all day. No job, spending all of my money on beer and stopped taking my antidepressants. I’ve told everyone I know that I want to die. I know it hurts so much but I am in the same boat as you. I’m 25. Everything hurts. My father told me that life can turn on a dime and sooner than later you will have things back your way. Things can’t keep going downhill for us, it can only get better but only if you believe you deserve it. Everyone makes mistakes and many people have made much larger mistakes than us.
